cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Give me the actual note, not your description. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

mechanism: A manages a visit plan and seeks the actual note controlling access, accepting reading first and limited disclosure to obtain the evidence needed to proceed.
confusable: Unlike arguing only with B interpretation, A wants direct access to the words; authority narrows inspection to protect privacy while preserving the practical decision.
comparison: A private family visit note differs from joint responsibility for club receipts behind a locked drawer.
seedUse: D132-a note versus description and one relevant line, grounded in visiting Dad; S02-b adapts inspection terms to B concerns.
